academic.passage: The study of neuroscience examines the structure and function of the nervous system, particularly the brain. It explores how neuronal communication contributes to behavior and cognitive functions. Advances in neuroimaging techniques have allowed scientists to observe brain activity in real-time, enhancing our understanding of neurological disorders. This field integrates knowledge from biology, psychology, and chemistry, making it a multidisciplinary area of research that is constantly evolving.
